title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Maasilamani
desc: Maasilamani falls in love with a woman, Divya, who dislikes him. Trouble ensues when he concocts an elaborate story about his lookalike to win her heart.

title: Mounaragam
desc: Divya is a lively young girl, who secretly mourns the death of her lover. She reluctantly agrees to an arranged marriage with Chandrakumar and faces difficulties.

title: Thirumalai
desc: A simple mechanic falls in love with a young girl. However, her father, who owns a television channel, opposes their relationship and enlists the help of a man to separate them.

title: LKG
desc: LKG, a councillor of a small town, aspires to become the chief minister of the state. He enlists the help of the corporates to impress the public but faces threat from another politician.

title: Kutty
desc: When Kutty falls for Geeta, he decides to confess his feelings but is left heartbroken to discover her relationship with her classmate Arjun.
